featured.whyImportant: 该分析指出中美关系在当前阶段仍处于僵持状态，象征性意义大于实际政策成果。

The news organisation was replaced by Real America’s Voice News, a conservative network, for the president’s trip to Knoxville, Tennessee, according to White House guidance. global.titleZh: 教皇警告：警惕在“机器天堂”中丧失人性
global.summaryZh: 教皇利奥在访问法国期间警告称，面对人工智能的快速发展，人类必须警惕在机器主导的生活中丧失人性。他强调，在机器入侵日常生活的背景下，进行伦理辨析教育已刻不容缓。
global.whyImportant: 教皇的言论凸显了宗教界对人工智能技术伦理风险的深切关注。

global.titleZh: 香港加速推进北部都会区交通建设，能否按时完工？
global.summaryZh: 香港政府正加速推进北部都会区关键道路工程，但专家和议员担忧基础设施建设可能滞后于住宅开发。他们建议尽快开通快速巴士路线并建设中央铁路，以确保区域交通连接。
global.whyImportant: 交通配套的滞后可能影响北部都会区作为重要发展区域的实际居住与通勤体验。

global.summary: US television networks resumed coverage of President Donald Trump’s White House events on Friday, providing the first live pool access for Chinese President Xi Jinping’s visit, as a legal battle continues over restrictions on CNN, MS Now and Politico. Trump last week banned the three outlets from the White House, before a judge ordered the administration to restore their access. global.titleZh: 中美在人工智能领域竞速，能否共同管控风险？
global.summaryZh: 在新加坡举行的论坛上，专家和行业领袖呼吁中美两国在人工智能领域建立安全护栏。尽管地缘政治紧张，但与会者强调，人工智能的快速发展迫切需要两国寻找共同点以加强风险控制。
global.whyImportant: 中美作为人工智能领域的领跑者，其合作对于全球技术安全标准的确立至关重要。

global.summaryZh: 中国国家主席习近平已抵达华盛顿，开启对美国的访问行程。此次访问受到美方高规格礼遇，备受国际社会关注。
global.whyImportant: 此次访问是中美关系中的重要外交事件，对双边关系走向具有深远影响。

global.title: Trump faces tough choices as Iran dangles deal to reopen Hormuz before US midterms
global.summary: Iran’s seven-day timetable would restart nuclear talks, but will the US be willing to deliver on terms that include reining in Israel in Lebanon? Iran’s seven-day timetable to reopen the strait of Hormuz and start talks on its nuclear programme has been pitched as a deal that could rapidly extricate Donald Trump from a political crisis but requires the US president to make difficult concessions. In the five days left before the proposed reopening of the strait, which is expected to relieve pressure on global energy markets, Trump would need to lift Iranian asset freezes, permit Iran to export its oil and, probably most difficult of all, order Benjamin Netanyahu to end Israel’s attacks on Hezbollah in Lebanon, thus achieving the “ceasefire on all fronts”. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 伊朗抛出重开霍尔木兹海峡协议，特朗普面临艰难抉择
global.summaryZh: 伊朗提出在七天内重启核谈判并重开霍尔木兹海峡，但要求美国解除资产冻结并促使以色列在黎巴嫩停火。这对特朗普而言是缓解能源市场压力和政治危机的机会，但也需要做出重大让步。
global.whyImportant: 该协议若达成，将对中东局势及美国中期选举前的能源价格产生重大影响。

global.title: Offshore wind farm could create radar blind spots and ‘ghost’ targets, Chinese study warns
global.summary: Offshore wind farms can reduce the coverage of shore-based radar systems and create areas where targets become harder to detect, according to a new study. The researchers found that at a range of 5km (3 miles), effective radar coverage fell by 6.9 per cent while blind spots increased by 14.9 per cent. The research, published online last month in the peer-reviewed Chinese journal Radio Engineering, was conducted by Professor Liu Zunnian and his team from Qingdao Technological University and the...
global.titleZh: 中国研究警告：海上风电场可能产生雷达盲区和“幽灵”目标
global.summaryZh: 一项由青岛理工大学团队进行的研究指出，海上风电场会削弱岸基雷达系统的覆盖范围，并增加探测难度。研究发现，在5公里范围内，雷达有效覆盖率下降了6.9%，盲区增加了14.9%。
global.whyImportant: 该研究揭示了可再生能源设施建设对海上航行安全和雷达监测带来的潜在技术挑战。

global.titleZh: 巴基斯坦总理告诉联合国：胡塞武装袭击麦加和麦地那将触及“红线”
global.summaryZh: 巴基斯坦总理夏巴兹·谢里夫在伊斯兰堡、利雅得和安卡拉的军队首脑讨论麦加协议及加强军事联系之际发表了上述言论。他强调任何针对圣城的袭击都将是不可逾越的底线。
global.whyImportant: 此表态凸显了伊斯兰国家对保护圣地安全的共同立场，并可能影响地区军事协作的走向。

global.title: Protests erupt as Netanyahu gives inflammatory UN speech - The Latest
global.summary: More than 100 people were arrested at large protests against the Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s address to the UN general assembly. Susan Sarandon, Chelsea Manning and Caleb Hearon were among the famous faces arrested. Inside the assembly hall, Netanyahu faced a mass walkout as he took to the stage. Then, in an inflammatory address, he claimed Israel’s war in Gaza was the ‘opposite of a genocide’ and labelled the New York mayor, Zohran Mamdani, antisemitic. Lucy Hough speaks to UK global editor Devika Bhat – watch on YouTube – Listen to Thursday’s episode of Stateside with Kai and Carter on whether Netanyahu has lost America here Continue reading...

global.titleZh: 内塔尼亚胡发表煽动性联合国演讲，引发大规模抗议
global.summaryZh: 以色列总理内塔尼亚胡在联合国大会演讲时遭遇大规模抗议和离场抵制，超过百人被捕。他在演讲中否认加沙战争构成种族灭绝，并指责纽约市长反犹太主义。
global.whyImportant: 此次事件反映了国际社会对以色列加沙政策的严重分歧，以及内塔尼亚胡在外交场合面临的巨大舆论压力。

items.summaryZh: 在新加坡举行的论坛上，专家和行业领袖呼吁中美两国在人工智能领域建立安全护栏。尽管地缘政治紧张，但与会者强调，人工智能的快速发展迫切需要两国寻找共同点以加强风险控制。
items.whyImportant: 中美作为人工智能领域的领跑者，其合作对于全球技术安全标准的确立至关重要。

items.title: 时政新闻眼丨习近平抵达华盛顿 ， 高规格礼遇开启访美序幕
tags: 专题·美国政策与全球影响
items.titleZh: 时政新闻眼丨习近平抵达华盛顿，高规格礼遇开启访美序幕
items.summaryZh: 中国国家主席习近平已抵达华盛顿，开启对美国的访问行程。此次访问受到美方高规格礼遇，备受国际社会关注。
items.whyImportant: 此次访问是中美关系中的重要外交事件，对双边关系走向具有深远影响。

items.title: Trump faces tough choices as Iran dangles deal to reopen Hormuz before US midterms
items.summary: Iran’s seven-day timetable would restart nuclear talks, but will the US be willing to deliver on terms that include reining in Israel in Lebanon? Iran’s seven-day timetable to reopen the strait of Hormuz and start talks on its nuclear programme has been pitched as a deal that could rapidly extricate Donald Trump from a political crisis but requires the US president to make difficult concessions. In the five days left before the proposed reopening of the strait, which is expected to relieve pressure on global energy markets, Trump would need to lift Iranian asset freezes, permit Iran to export its oil and, probably most difficult of all, order Benjamin Netanyahu to end Israel’s attacks on Hezbollah in Lebanon, thus achieving the “ceasefire on all fronts”. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 伊朗抛出重开霍尔木兹海峡协议，特朗普面临艰难抉择
items.summaryZh: 伊朗提出在七天内重启核谈判并重开霍尔木兹海峡，但要求美国解除资产冻结并促使以色列在黎巴嫩停火。这对特朗普而言是缓解能源市场压力和政治危机的机会，但也需要做出重大让步。
items.whyImportant: 该协议若达成，将对中东局势及美国中期选举前的能源价格产生重大影响。

items.title: Offshore wind farm could create radar blind spots and ‘ghost’ targets, Chinese study warns
items.summary: Offshore wind farms can reduce the coverage of shore-based radar systems and create areas where targets become harder to detect, according to a new study. The researchers found that at a range of 5km (3 miles), effective radar coverage fell by 6.9 per cent while blind spots increased by 14.9 per cent. The research, published online last month in the peer-reviewed Chinese journal Radio Engineering, was conducted by Professor Liu Zunnian and his team from Qingdao Technological University and the...
items.titleZh: 中国研究警告：海上风电场可能产生雷达盲区和“幽灵”目标
items.summaryZh: 一项由青岛理工大学团队进行的研究指出，海上风电场会削弱岸基雷达系统的覆盖范围，并增加探测难度。研究发现，在5公里范围内，雷达有效覆盖率下降了6.9%，盲区增加了14.9%。
items.whyImportant: 该研究揭示了可再生能源设施建设对海上航行安全和雷达监测带来的潜在技术挑战。

items.title: Houthi attack on Mecca, Medina would cross ‘red line’, Pakistan PM tells UN
items.summary: Shehbaz Sharif speaks as Islamabad, Riyadh and Ankara army chiefs meet to discuss Mecca pact, closer military ties.
items.titleZh: 巴基斯坦总理告诉联合国：胡塞武装袭击麦加和麦地那将触及“红线”
items.summaryZh: 巴基斯坦总理夏巴兹·谢里夫在伊斯兰堡、利雅得和安卡拉的军队首脑讨论麦加协议及加强军事联系之际发表了上述言论。他强调任何针对圣城的袭击都将是不可逾越的底线。
items.whyImportant: 此表态凸显了伊斯兰国家对保护圣地安全的共同立场，并可能影响地区军事协作的走向。

items.title: Protests erupt as Netanyahu gives inflammatory UN speech - The Latest
items.summary: More than 100 people were arrested at large protests against the Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s address to the UN general assembly. Susan Sarandon, Chelsea Manning and Caleb Hearon were among the famous faces arrested. Inside the assembly hall, Netanyahu faced a mass walkout as he took to the stage. Then, in an inflammatory address, he claimed Israel’s war in Gaza was the ‘opposite of a genocide’ and labelled the New York mayor, Zohran Mamdani, antisemitic. items.titleZh: 内塔尼亚胡发表煽动性联合国演讲，引发大规模抗议
items.summaryZh: 以色列总理内塔尼亚胡在联合国大会演讲时遭遇大规模抗议和离场抵制，超过百人被捕。他在演讲中否认加沙战争构成种族灭绝，并指责纽约市长反犹太主义。
items.whyImportant: 此次事件反映了国际社会对以色列加沙政策的严重分歧，以及内塔尼亚胡在外交场合面临的巨大舆论压力。

items.title: White House blocks CNN from Air Force One in latest escalation with news media
items.summary: Outlet had been scheduled to fly with Donald Trump to Tennessee for a college football game, network said Friday The White House has blocked CNN from traveling aboard Air Force One on Saturday, impeding its TV press pool duties in the latest escalation of the administration’s battle with the news media. CNN had been scheduled to fly with Donald Trump to Tennessee for a college football game, the network said on Friday. The White House confirmed CNN’s exclusion when it did not list the network on guidance sent to the press corps regarding Trump’s schedule for Saturday. Continue reading...

items.titleZh: 白宫禁止CNN随行空军一号，媒体关系进一步恶化
items.summaryZh: 白宫在周五发布的行程指南中排除了CNN，阻止其随特朗普总统前往田纳西州进行报道。此举阻碍了该媒体履行随行记者团的职责，标志着双方冲突的升级。
items.whyImportant: 此举被视为白宫对新闻媒体施加压力和限制报道权限的又一例证。

items.title: Trump cancels nearly $1bn in funding approved by Congress
items.summary: President using rare power to revoke expenditure with bipartisan approval to aid immigrant services Donald Trump is canceling nearly $1bn in spending approved by Congress, the White House announced on Friday, using a rare and contested power to axe funding for immigrant services and diversity-focused initiatives. Trump’s office of management and budget described the funding cut as focused on “the most harmful government spending”. Continue reading...

items.titleZh: 特朗普取消近10亿美元国会批准的资金
items.summaryZh: 白宫周五宣布，特朗普总统将动用罕见的行政权力，取消近10亿美元已获国会批准的支出。这些资金原定用于移民服务及多元化相关项目，被白宫列为“有害的政府支出”。
items.whyImportant: 此举展示了总统在财政支出决策上对国会权威的挑战，引发了关于行政权力的争议。

items.titleZh: 习特国宴：从酒瓶到美国科技巨头出席，回顾不容错过的细节
items.summaryZh: 在周四的白宫国宴上，美国科技界领袖受邀出席，显示出华盛顿目前主要通过技术视角审视美中关系。此次宴会不仅是外交场合，也反映了双方在科技领域的博弈与互动。
items.whyImportant: 科技巨头的出席凸显了技术竞争在当前美中双边关系中的核心地位。

items.title: Xi presses Trump to take the next step on Taiwan: oppose independence
items.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping pressed his US counterpart Donald Trump to explicitly oppose Taiwan independence – a call that would require a shift in Washington’s long-standing position and further restraint on American arms sales to the island, according to analysts. During the meeting between the two leaders on Thursday, Xi said he hoped the US side would “adhere to the correct position of opposing ‘Taiwan independence’”, according to a statement from the foreign ministry in Beijing. items.titleZh: 习近平敦促特朗普在台湾问题上采取进一步行动：反对“台独”
items.summaryZh: 中国国家主席习近平在与特朗普的会晤中，敦促美方明确反对“台独”。分析人士指出，这要求华盛顿改变长期立场并进一步限制对台军售。
items.whyImportant: 此举显示中国在台湾问题上对美方施加更大压力，要求其在核心利益上做出明确表态。

items.titleZh: 香港企业如何在充满挑战的时代实现业务未来化
items.summaryZh: 香港经济正处于转型关键期，私营企业需积极适应变化。通过数字化转型和技术应用，香港企业正在探索提升竞争力的路径。
items.whyImportant: 该报道探讨了香港企业在宏观经济转型背景下的生存与发展策略。
